userStories.title: Generate sprint stories for context-matching focus area
userStories.notes: Generated 11 stories (US-75-002 through US-75-012) covering context-matching focus area: description relevance scoring, metadata propagation, LLM reranker context expansion, description-enriched embeddings, tag-based scoring, video_metadata plumbing, chapter-aware scoring, chapter source consistency, description-derived iterative queries, chapter coherence penalty, and comprehensive test coverage.

userStories.title: Add description relevance scoring adjustment to apply_all_adjustments
acceptanceCriteria: New function `apply_description_relevance_adjustment` exists in `src/matching/scoring.py` that computes keyword overlap between voiceover segment text and video description
Graduated boost applied: 1 keyword match -> +0.02, 2 matches -> +0.04, 3+ matches -> +0.06
Adjustment appears in `confidence_breakdown` dict as `description_relevance` entry with numeric value
Function is called from `apply_all_adjustments()` when video_metadata contains a description
Unit test verifies graduated boost values for 0, 1, 2, 3+ keyword matches
Unit test verifies `description_relevance` key exists in confidence_breakdown after adjustment

userStories.title: Propagate video_description from caption_results to text_metadata in caption_stage
acceptanceCriteria: `_populate_text_metadata()` in `src/stages/caption_stage.py` copies `video_description` from each `CaptionResult` into text_metadata dict keyed by video_id
Description is available in text_metadata alongside existing title data for downstream consumers
Backward compatible: missing description defaults to empty string, no crash on old cache data
Unit test verifies description propagation from CaptionResult to text_metadata
Unit test verifies graceful handling when CaptionResult has no video_description field (old cache)
userStories.notes: Added `video_description = result.get('video_description', '')` extraction and included it in text_metadata entry dict. 5 tests in test_description_propagation_us75_003.py covering: propagation, multi-segment, missing field (old cache), coexistence with other fields, multi-video independence.

Tier: FOUNDATION (enables US-75-002, US-75-004, US-75-005). Files: `src/stages/caption_stage.py` lines ~1717-1777 (`_populate_text_metadata`). Currently only title_lookup is built from video_search_results. Need to also build description_lookup from caption_results[video_id].video_description. The CaptionResult already has the field (line 570 of models.py) but it's not propagated.

userStories.title: Expand LLM reranker to use full description context instead of first sentence only
acceptanceCriteria: `_enrich_candidates_with_context()` in `src/matching/llm_reranker.py` uses up to 300 chars of description (not just first sentence/100 chars)
New config option `context_enrichment.reranker_max_description_length: 300` controls truncation length
Config dataclass `ContextEnrichmentConfig` in `src/config/sections/matching.py` has `reranker_max_description_length: int = 300` field
Config also added to `config.yaml` under `matching.context_enrichment`
Unit test verifies description truncation respects configurable max length
Unit test verifies enriched text format includes longer description
userStories.notes: Tier: HIGH IMPACT (LLM gets more context signal). Files: `src/matching/llm_reranker.py` lines ~198-224 (`_enrich_candidates_with_context`), `src/config/sections/matching.py` lines ~167-181 (ContextEnrichmentConfig), `config.yaml` lines ~583-590. Currently truncates to first sentence or 100 chars (line ~200). Increasing to 300 gives LLM much better context without overwhelming the prompt.

userStories.title: Add description-enriched embeddings option alongside title enrichment
acceptanceCriteria: New config option `context_enrichment.description_enriched_embeddings: bool = False` in ContextEnrichmentConfig
When enabled, `_populate_text_metadata()` prepends `[{title} - {first_50_chars_of_description}]` to embedding text instead of just `[{title}]`
Config added to both `src/config/sections/matching.py` and `config.yaml`
Default is False (description enrichment is experimental, title-only is proven)
Unit test verifies embedding text format with description enrichment enabled vs disabled
Unit test verifies description truncated to 50 chars for embedding prefix
userStories.notes: Tier: MEDIUM (experimental - embedding models may or may not benefit from description context). Files: `src/stages/caption_stage.py` lines ~1765-1777 (where title_enriched_embeddings is applied), `src/config/sections/matching.py` line ~177. Default False because adding too much text to embedding prefix can dilute semantic signal. Test file: `tests/test_caption_stage.py` or `tests/test_context_enrichment.py`.

userStories.title: Add tag-based semantic keyword boost in scoring
acceptanceCriteria: New function `apply_tag_keyword_boost` in `src/matching/scoring.py` computes overlap between voiceover segment keywords and video tags from video_metadata
Tags are lowercased and split on commas/spaces before comparison
Graduated boost: 1 tag match -> +0.02, 2+ matches -> +0.04, with cap at +0.06
Adjustment appears in `confidence_breakdown` as `tag_relevance` entry
Unit test verifies tag matching with various tag formats (single words, multi-word tags, mixed case)
Unit test verifies boost cap prevents excessive scoring from videos with many tags
userStories.notes: Tier: MEDIUM (tags are noisy but can be useful signal). Files: `src/matching/scoring.py` (add near other relevance adjustments ~line 2268). video_tags are already extracted and stored in CaptionResult (line 572 of models.py) and DownloadedVideo (line 84 of state.py). Need to pass tags through video_metadata dict from tiered_matcher.py. The interview notes mention reusing existing keyword_boost mechanism, but a separate function is cleaner for audit trail.

userStories.title: Pass video_metadata with description and tags through TieredMatcher to scoring
acceptanceCriteria: TieredMatcher's `video_metadata` dict includes `description` and `tags` fields per video (not just `title`)
Match stage (`src/stages/match.py`) populates video_metadata with description from caption_results and tags from caption_results
Scoring functions receive video_metadata containing title, description, and tags for each candidate
Unit test verifies video_metadata dict structure includes title, description, and tags
Unit test verifies scoring functions can access description and tags from video_metadata
userStories.notes: Tier: HIGH (plumbing prerequisite for US-75-002 and US-75-006). Files: `src/matching/tiered_matcher.py` lines ~127-141 (init), ~636-644 (metadata usage), ~968 (reranker call). `src/stages/match.py` where TieredMatcher is instantiated and video_metadata is built. Currently video_metadata = {video_id: {title: str, description: str}} but description may not be populated from caption_results. Need to verify and fix the plumbing from caption_results -> video_metadata -> scoring.

userStories.title: Add chapter-aware scoring adjustment for video chapter topic matching
acceptanceCriteria: New function `apply_chapter_topic_match_adjustment` in `src/matching/scoring.py` checks if candidate segment falls within a video chapter whose title/keywords overlap with voiceover segment text
Topic match boost: +0.05 for 1 keyword overlap, +0.08 for 2+ overlaps between chapter title words and voiceover keywords
Adjustment appears in `confidence_breakdown` as `chapter_topic_match` entry
Gracefully skips when video has no chapters (most videos won't have chapters)
Unit test verifies boost values for chapter title keyword overlap
Unit test verifies no crash or penalty when video_chapters is empty
userStories.notes: Tier: MEDIUM (only applies to videos with YouTube chapters, which is a subset). Files: `src/matching/scoring.py` (add new adjustment function), `src/caption/models.py` (VideoChapter already exists if chapter_detection module is present). video_chapters are extracted in caption_fetcher.py (line ~2314-2323) and stored in CaptionResult (line 571). Need to pass chapter data through video_metadata to scoring. Depends on US-75-007 for plumbing.

userStories.title: Add chapter source consistency boost within voiceover sections
acceptanceCriteria: New function `apply_chapter_source_consistency_boost` in `src/matching/scoring.py` adds +0.03 when candidate is from same video source as previous match in the same voiceover chapter/listicle group
Requires voiceover chapter context (chapter boundaries from chapter_detection module)
Boost only applies within chapter boundaries - cross-chapter diversity is preserved
Adjustment appears in `confidence_breakdown` as `chapter_source_consistency` entry
Unit test verifies boost applied for same-source within chapter
Unit test verifies no boost applied across chapter boundaries
userStories.notes: Tier: LOW (polish - requires both chapter detection and sequential match awareness). Files: `src/matching/scoring.py`. This adjustment needs knowledge of previous matches within the same voiceover chapter, which requires passing chapter grouping info and match history into the scoring context. May need to extend scoring function signature or add a scoring context object. Depends on chapter_detection module being functional.

userStories.title: Add description-derived search queries for iterative match gap filling
acceptanceCriteria: Gap analyzer in `src/iterative_match/gap_analyzer.py` extracts key phrases from descriptions of already-matched videos when generating search queries for unfilled gaps
New config option `iterative_match.use_description_queries: bool = True` in iterative matching config
Config added to both config dataclass and config.yaml
Key phrase extraction uses simple noun-phrase heuristic (2-3 word phrases from description text)
Unit test verifies key phrase extraction from sample video descriptions
Unit test verifies description-derived queries are included in gap-filling search queries
userStories.notes: Tier: MEDIUM (improves iterative match quality for hard-to-fill gaps). Files: `src/iterative_match/gap_analyzer.py` (lines ~30-149), `src/config/sections/matching.py` or iterative match config. Gap analyzer currently uses word lists (ABSTRACT_CONCEPTS, EMOTION_WORDS, ACTION_VERBS, LOCATION_INDICATORS) to classify gaps. Adding description-derived queries gives more targeted search terms from videos that already matched well.

userStories.title: Add chapter coherence penalty for scattered video sources within voiceover sections
acceptanceCriteria: New function `apply_chapter_coherence_penalty` in `src/matching/scoring.py` tracks unique video sources used within each voiceover chapter/section
Penalty of -0.03 applied when a voiceover section already uses 5+ different video sources and candidate would add another
Configurable threshold via `matching.chapter_grouping.coherence_penalty_threshold: int = 5`
Config added to matching config dataclass and config.yaml
Adjustment appears in `confidence_breakdown` as `chapter_coherence` entry
Unit test verifies penalty triggers at threshold and not below it
userStories.notes: Tier: LOW (polish - prevents excessive scatter but requires match history tracking). Files: `src/matching/scoring.py`, `src/config/sections/matching.py`, `config.yaml`. This is a quality-of-output improvement that prevents a voiceover section about one topic from pulling clips from too many unrelated videos. Requires tracking which sources have been selected for each voiceover section during matching.

userStories.title: Add comprehensive test coverage for context-enriched matching pipeline
acceptanceCriteria: New test file `tests/test_context_enrichment.py` with at least 8 test cases covering the context-matching feature set

Tests cover: description extraction from info_dict, description propagation through pipeline, title+description enriched scoring, tag matching, chapter topic matching, LLM reranker context injection, config toggle behavior
All tests use mock data (no network calls) and run with `--non-interactive`
Tests verify backward compatibility: old cache entries without description/chapters/tags fields don't crash
Tests verify config toggles: disabling `extract_video_description` prevents description from appearing in scoring
userStories.notes: Tier: MEDIUM (test coverage for the full context-matching feature set). Files: new `tests/test_context_enrichment.py`. Should import from `src/matching/scoring.py`, `src/matching/llm_reranker.py`, `src/caption/models.py`, `src/config/sections/matching.py`. Use fixtures from `tests/conftest.py` where applicable. Mark tests with `@pytest.mark.fast` for inclusion in quick test runs.
